author: resepignev
body:
Thread Editors

A Suggestion by resepignev

The Idea:

Wouldn't it be great if you could add people that want to help you to manage a tournament or event?
Did you and your friend create a map, but you can't decide who posts the map?
Do you both want to edit and update the thread?

If the answer is yes then this is the right thing for you!
With this suggestion you can add users to your thread.
They can edit the title, the body and archive the thread. Everything that they could do if they created the thread.
As I already said it would be perfect if you are managing an event and you need someone else to update the thread.

Another usage would be for reports, appeals or staff discussions in case a player needs to be added.
For example at reports if another player has additional evidence of a player breaking the rules or at appeals if a former staff member wants to provide evidence.


How it would look:

Basically the only addition would be this little box at the bottom of the thread. If someone is added they have the same permissions as the thread creator. (Except adding more people to that post).
To remove someone from your post, just click the checkmark (I know it should be a cross) and the user is removed from the list.
The Thread wouldn't look different in any kind. No mentions of the contributors or whatsoever. The only thing that changes that another user has access to the thread.
The user that got invited will get an alert that notifies him that he is now able to edit/manage the thread. The same would happen if his permissions for editing are getting revoked.


How it works:

To be honest I have absolutely no idea how to make it work or code it. I guess it would be work like the "teams" section under the competitive point. It's all up to the developers :D

I'm all open for more suggestions, improvements and also critic, but keep in mind it should be constructive!
Also Praise my html skillz!
